title: What If A Time Machine Actually Worked?
description: An inventor spends everything on a time machine - then discovers that going back one hour lands you 107,000 km from Earth, because our planet never sits still (about 29.78 km/s around the Sun). Fiction for fun; the orbital numbers are real. Original 3D+2D animation.
coverPromise: A smug inventor in front of a glowing time-machine ring, a tiny bow-tie man floating in deep space inside it, and a rewinding clock icon.
first15Seconds: Opens on the hammer strike that finishes the machine, pulls back to reveal its scale, then the empty wallet gag and the rival; by 15 s the first test has already sent a dummy away.

provenance.cover: Staged original actor/props from the film scene, code-drawn flat clock icon, not an actual video frame.
provenance.audio: Narration, score and 7 effects generated with ElevenLabs on 2026-11-07 with the user chat authorisation; three library effects reused; mix measured only, not listened to by the agent.
